readme.markdown:
# BotFactory MCP Farm

Hosted MCP servers on [MCPize](https://mcpize.com) — zero-auth public APIs, freemium x402 (USDC on Base).

## Catalog

See [CATALOG.md](./CATALOG.md) for the full list with gateway URLs.

## Connect

```
https://<slug>.mcpize.run/mcp
```

Requires an x402-capable MCP client for paid tools. `health_check` and discovery tools are free.

## Awesome list entries

See [AWESOME_ENTRIES.md](./AWESOME_ENTRIES.md).

toolsPreview.name: get_country_info
toolsPreview.description:
Get travel country facts: capital, region, income level via World Bank API.
    code: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (US, FR, UA). Returns country profile fields.

toolsPreview.name: get_weather
toolsPreview.description:
Get current weather for a city worldwide via Open-Meteo + OSM geocoding.
    Returns: {city, lat, lon, temperature_c, windspeed_kmh, weather_code}

toolsPreview.name: convert_travel_currency
toolsPreview.description:
Convert travel budget between currencies using live Frankfurter rates.
    Returns: {amount, from, to, result, rate, date}
